## Problem and behavior

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and affected apps/packages. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain skipped checks and remaining limitations. Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe any API/decision changes, migrations, environment variables, dependencies, or dataset/Redis-format changes. Include false-positive cases for detection changes and source/terms information for new feeds. Write "None" if not applicable.

## Contribution notes

Mention material AI assistance and how you reviewed its output. Confirm the change contains no credentials, private user data, generated media, or unlicensed copied material.
